qa-crawler.description: QA coverage crawler engine (run `pnpm build` first). Point a run's browser.mode at `neko` to drive Neko over CDP. In another project, use the absolute path to dist/index.js.

playwright.description: Playwright MCP bound to the SAME Neko browser over CDP. Generic browser tools, visible in Neko. Set QA_NEKO_CDP for a remote Neko (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9223 via an SSH tunnel to the remote host).
